calendars.title: Calendrier national de l'année universitaire 2026-2027 (circulaire du Ministère de l'Enseignement supérieur, rapportée par La Presse)
calendars.summary: National, not university-specific. Rentrée Tue 1 Sep 2026 for IPEI, engineering schools, medical/dental/pharmacy faculties and ISETs; Sat 12 Sep 2026 for all other institutions. Min. 28 weeks of teaching. Winter break 12-27 Dec 2026; spring break 19 Mar-4 Apr 2027. Holidays: 15 Oct 2026, 17 Dec 2026, 1 Jan 2027, 20 Mar 2027, 9 Apr 2027, 1 May 2027; Aid dates set later. No exam-session dates given.

gaps: University documents count 19-20 teaching establishments (05 facultés, 04 écoles, 10-11 instituts) + 1 research institute; 20 teaching establishments listed here. Facebook URL comes from university PDFs (via search summary), not verified live.
2026-27 per-institute rentrée/registration dates appear only on orientini (e.g. FSS prep 6 Sep, licence/master 12 Sep 2026).
Official *.rnu.tn sites (university and most institutes) refused connections from the research environment, so news pages, Moodle URLs and calendars on them could not be checked live.
No institute-specific Facebook/Instagram pages, public student groups (Facebook/Telegram) or old-exam archives could be confirmed via search; left empty rather than guessed.
Equipment needs: no source found stating field-specific equipment; left empty.

universite.tn program lists use pre-reform (LA/LF) names and may be outdated; orientini data (codes, 2025 cut-offs) is third-party but mirrors the national orientation guide - cross-check with orientation.tn guide.
Masters are mostly missing except where universite.tn or the university site list them.
ISETs in the region (DGET network, not under the university) are excluded.
